newsitem.title: UK: UK grain futures under pressure from sterling/farm.
newsitem.headline: UK grain futures under pressure from sterling/farm.

text.p: LIFFE grain futures closed sharply lower on Wednesday with values under pressure from sterling and farm selling.
"Sterling is still weighing on the market and now farmers have appeared," said a trader.
Traders on the cash market also reported farm selling with farmers fearing a further drop in the market.
Wheat futures closed 1.30 to 0.70 stg down after trading 402 lots.
Most active Mar last traded at 94.50 stg, 1.20 stg down with 200 lots sold.
Barley finished 0.85 to 1.15 stg down on a turnover of 135 lots.
Most active positions was Mar which had a last trade of 93.90 stg, 0.85 stg down after trading 105 lots.
